PLAN "12-Week Home Strength Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOAL primary strength
name "Build full-body strength using bodyweight and pull-up bar"
END GOAL
GOAL secondary hypertrophy
name "Develop muscle mass through progressive overload"
END GOAL
END GOALS

PHASES
PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 45m "Push Day A"
WARMUP
jog_in_place 5 minutes
arm_circles 60 seconds
jumping_jack 60 seconds
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
push_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
dip 3x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
tricep_dip 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
chest_stretch 30 seconds
shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
tricep_stretch 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 45m "Pull Day A"
WARMUP
jog_in_place 5 minutes
arm_circles 60 seconds
scapular_retraction 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
pull_up 3x3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
chin_up 3x3 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
inverted_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
lat_stretch 30 seconds
back_stretch 30 seconds
child_pose 60 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday training 45m "Legs and Core A"
WARMUP
jog_in_place 5 minutes

END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
reverse_lunge 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
